scope: Read-only execution-link/provenance audit for the fixed NIR peak and optical information in the ten existing DES16 signed-refit objects. No fits, effect sizes, or preferred corrections.
prior_known_result: The RAISIN differential report already established that NIR peak matches photometry-header peak within printing and differs from final optical/combined peaks; this audit adds ten-object exact source/configuration/simulation metadata joins.
sources: released DES optical/NIR/combined NML and FITOPT000 distance tables
pinned author DES SIMLIB and generator/fit NML as available configurations
joins: Exact CID for photometry and released FITRES; exact FIELD for SIMLIB; retain duplicate or missing header values/blocks. No nearest-neighbour substitutions.
limits: The script that originally generated the released photometry-header peak, its effective run, and the private raisin_t0.txt used by genSimlib.py are not established by source naming. Distinguish static NIR fit dependence from sample selection and fixed published bias correction.
forbidden: No native fits or simulations, no signed-correction magnitude, no cosmology inference.
